subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar, nos debates, operadores argumentativos que marcam a defesa de ideia e de diálogo com a tese do outro: concordo, discordo, concordo parcialmente, do meu ponto de vista, na perspectiva aqui assumida etc.

components.description_pt: Usar operadores argumentativos que sinalizam concordância, discordância ou concordância parcial em debates orais
components.description_en: Use argumentative operators that signal agreement, disagreement, or partial agreement in oral debates
components.cc_component_description: Select precise words and phrases that signal logical relationships among reasons and evidence

components.description_pt: Aplicar expressões de posição e perspectiva — como 'do meu ponto de vista' — para marcar posicionamento em debate
components.description_en: Apply expressions of position and perspective — such as 'from my point of view' — to mark stance in a debate
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a speaker's point of view for clarity and logical consistency

components.description_pt: Usar marcadores linguísticos de engajamento com uma tese oposta durante trocas argumentativas
components.description_en: Use linguistic markers of engagement with an opposing thesis during argumentative exchanges
components.cc_component_description: Acknowledge alternate or opposing claims within an argumentative text

cc_matches.description: Use words, phrases, and clauses to create cohesion and clarify the relationships among claim(s), counterclaims, reasons, and evidence.
Introduce claim(s), acknowledge alternate or opposing claims, and organize the reasons and evidence logically.
Evaluate a speaker's point of view, reasoning, and use of evidence and rhetoric, identifying any fallacious reasoning or exaggerated or distorted evidence.
